prompt: Our lazy ginger cat somehow caught two grey (mouse) under the kitchen cupboard.
explanation_ru: Существительное mouse образует множественное число не по правилу: mice (форма mouses неверна).

prompt: Those twelve white (sheep) didn't move off the narrow country lane for us.
explanation_ru: У слова sheep форма множественного числа совпадает с единственным: twelve sheep, без окончания -s.

prompt: How many silver (fish) did Callum catch from the wooden boat?
explanation_ru: Обычная форма множественного числа слова fish совпадает с единственным — fish (форму fishes используют лишь для разных видов рыб).

prompt: We didn't expect to see three brown (deer) beside the forest path.
explanation_ru: Существительное deer не меняется во множественном числе: three deer, а не deers.

prompt: Can I pick up two (kilo) of ripe red (tomato) from the corner market stall?
explanation_ru: Сокращённое слово kilo принимает только -s (kilos), тогда как tomato относится к словам на -o с окончанием -es (tomatoes).

prompt: Don't touch the folded notes because the money in that blue envelope (to belong) to my older brother.
explanation_ru: В отличие от русского «деньги», английское money — неисчисляемое существительное и требует глагол в единственном числе: belongs.

prompt: Honestly, the climbing equipment in our school gym (to look) far too worn to use safely.
explanation_ru: Существительное equipment («оборудование») неисчисляемое и всегда согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе: looks.

prompt: When Vikram shouted inside the empty stone tunnel, sharp (echo) bounced straight back from the damp walls.
explanation_ru: Существительное echo входит в группу слов на -o, которые во множественном числе принимают окончание -es: echoes.

prompt: Before submitting your photography portfolio, please check that the official (criterion) for the student prize are met in full.
explanation_ru: У заимствованного существительного criterion особая форма множественного числа — criteria (на это также указывает глагол are).

prompt: Nadia's documentary explains several strange weather (phenomenon) that pilots sometimes notice high above the North Sea during winter storms.
explanation_ru: Слово phenomenon образует множественное число по греческому образцу — phenomena (форма phenomenons неверна).

prompt: Farid told me that the friendly couple downstairs (to be) both retired and spend most of the year travelling by rail.
explanation_ru: Собирательное существительное couple в сочетании со словом both и глаголом spend обозначает двух людей и требует форму are.

prompt: Rain kept everyone indoors at my aunt's house. Three excited (child) ran down the hall with wet (foot). Soon the loud noise upstairs (to be) impossible to ignore. Finally, Aunt Samira handed out puzzles to calm them down.
explanation_ru: Слова child и foot имеют особые формы множественного числа (children, feet), а неисчисляемое noise требует глагол в единственном числе (was).

prompt: Last Sunday, Kasia helped her grandfather clear out his dusty attic. Along the back wall, two long wooden (shelf) bent under the weight of old books. Inside three cardboard (box), they discovered travel maps and five leather (diary) from the 1970s. She spent the whole afternoon reading his notes.
explanation_ru: Три разные модели множественного числа: -f меняется на -ves (shelves), после -x добавляется -es (boxes), а согласная + -y даёт -ies (diaries).

prompt: Over the past decade, two rival bike makers expanded quickly across Europe. Both (company) opened new repair (branch) in six major cities. Their steady growth brought fresh jobs and changed many local (life) for the better. As a result, cyclists can find spare parts almost everywhere.
explanation_ru: В слове company конечная -y после согласной меняется на -ies (companies), после -ch в branch добавляется -es (branches), а -fe в life переходит в -ves (lives).

prompt: Channel Four didn't disappoint mystery fans this autumn. The network released two clever detective (series) filmed in coastal villages. Unlike older shows, the main (hero) make realistic mistakes instead of solving crimes effortlessly. Unsurprisingly, the news about a third season (to sound) wonderful to viewers.
explanation_ru: Слово series не меняется во множественном числе, слово hero принимает -es (heroes), а неисчисляемое news всегда требует глагол в единственном числе (sounds).

prompt: Gareth writes weekly football reports from his seat behind the north goal. Even without their injured goalkeeper, Liverpool (to play) with remarkable confidence and attack down both wings. Whenever they score, supporters lift their red (scarf) high into the cold air. After tough away (match), the players walk over to applaud the travelling fans.
explanation_ru: В британском английском названия спортивных команд с контекстом their согласуются со множественным числом (play); scarf даёт форму scarves, а после -ch в match добавляется -es (matches).

prompt: Rising fuel bills have created difficult (time) for small rural bakeries across the county. To cut waste, Ingrid's shop now bakes fewer white (loaf) on quiet weekdays. Fortunately, positive feedback from regular customers (to keep) the staff hopeful despite tighter budgets. Local residents say they cannot imagine the village square without the smell of fresh bread.
explanation_ru: В значении «времена, период» слово time исчисляемое (times), в слове loaf конечная -f меняется на -ves (loaves), а неисчисляемое feedback требует глагол keeps.

prompt: Is it true that the weather along the coast ___ awful during your trip?
explanation_ru: Существительное weather неисчисляемое и всегда требует глагол в единственном числе: was, а не were.

prompt: This seaside café serves three kinds of fresh ___ with lemon and herbs.
explanation_ru: Название рыбы salmon не принимает окончание -s во множественном числе: правильная форма — salmon.

prompt: A number of choir students ___ missing from the morning rehearsal because their bus broke down.
explanation_ru: Сочетание a number of («несколько, ряд») всегда требует глагол во множественном числе (are), в отличие от the number of.

prompt: Despite limited charging points in older estates, the number of electric cars on our narrow city roads ___ steadily.
explanation_ru: В конструкции the number of + существительное подлежащим является слово number в единственном числе, поэтому правильный вариант — is rising.

prompt: My English homework were not easy, so I asked my brother for help.
answer: My English homework was not easy, so I asked my brother for help.
accepted_answers: My English homework was not easy, so I asked my brother for help.
My English homework wasn't easy, so I asked my brother for help.
explanation_ru: Слово homework неисчисляемое и согласуется только с глаголом в единственном числе: was, а не were.

prompt: Progress on the new cycle lane was slow at first, yet the builders finished before autumn.
answer: Progress on the new cycle lane was slow at first, yet the builders finished before autumn.
accepted_answers: Progress on the new cycle lane was slow at first, yet the builders finished before autumn.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: неисчисляемое существительное progress употребляется без окончания -s и правильно согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе (was).

prompt: Three weeks without a working lift feel like a very long time when you carry shopping up six floors.
answer: Three weeks without a working lift feels like a very long time when you carry shopping up six floors.
accepted_answers: Three weeks without a working lift feels like a very long time when you carry shopping up six floors.
explanation_ru: Период времени Three weeks воспринимается здесь как один отрезок, поэтому требуется глагол в единственном числе: feels, а не feel.

prompt: You and your friend Tunde sit down at a small café near the bus station. You want to order one cup of coffee for yourself and one for him.
options: Could we have two coffee and a glass of water, please?
Could we have two coffees and a glass of water, please?
Could we have two coffies and a glass of water, please?
Could we have a coffees and a glass of water, please?
explanation_ru: При заказе порций слово coffee становится исчисляемым и принимает простое окончание -s: two coffees.

prompt: Elena is writing a positive review of a small Italian restaurant near the harbour. She wants to praise its wide selection of red and white varieties from different regions.
options: The restaurant's Italian wine are wonderfully varied and fairly priced for the harbour area.
The restaurant's Italian wines is wonderfully varied and fairly priced for the harbour area.
The restaurant's many Italian wine are wonderfully varied and fairly priced for the harbour area.
The restaurant's Italian wines are wonderfully varied and fairly priced for the harbour area.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о разных сортах вина, слово wine употребляется во множественном числе (wines) с глаголом are.

prompt: This soft French cheese is very popular with tourists at our weekend market. → These soft …
answer: These soft French cheeses are very popular with tourists at our weekend market.
accepted_answers: These soft French cheeses are very popular with tourists at our weekend market.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения разных сортов сыра используется исчисляемая форма множественного числа cheeses и глагол are.

prompt: That small family business hasn't raised its prices during the quiet winter months. → Those small …
answer: Those small family businesses haven't raised their prices during the quiet winter months.
accepted_answers: Those small family businesses haven't raised their prices during the quiet winter months.
Those small family businesses have not raised their prices during the quiet winter months.
explanation_ru: В значении «компания, предприятие» слово business исчисляемое (businesses); при переходе во множественное число меняются также глагол (haven't) и местоимение (their).
